# FIGURE S1 : Distribution of the number of days per 1500 periods and trials per day.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)

# Graphique principal (vue d'ensemble)
p1 <- ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = days)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 0.25,
    boundary = 0.5,
    fill = "skyblue",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of days per 1500 trial period",
    y = "Occurrence"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +  # Pas d’espace à gauche/droite
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +  # Démarre à 0 sur l’axe Y
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +          # Taille de base augmentée
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1)
  )

# Graphique zoomé (xlim 0–50)
p2 <- ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = days)) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 1,
    boundary = 0.5,
    fill = "skyblue",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 50), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
  )

# Combine les deux (p2 comme zoom dans p1)
p1 +
  annotation_custom(
    grob = ggplotGrob(p2),
    xmin = 75, xmax = 200,   # position horizontale de l'encart
    ymin = 35, ymax = 100    # position verticale de l'encart
  )

# Calcul de la moyenne des moyennes
mean_of_means <- trials_per_day %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  summarise(mean_trials = mean(n_trials, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  summarise(global_mean = mean(mean_trials, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(global_mean)

# Définir les breaks de l'axe Y pour inclure la moyenne des moyennes
y_breaks <- pretty(trials_per_day$n_trials)
y_breaks <- sort(unique(c(y_breaks, mean_of_means)))  # ajoute mean_of_means aux breaks

# Graphique
ggplot(trials_per_day, aes(x = as.factor(subject_id), y = n_trials)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, fill = "white", color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", color = "red", size = 3) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = mean_of_means,
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = y_breaks,
    labels = function(x) ifelse(x == mean_of_means, paste0("Mean: ", round(x,1)), x)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Monkeys",
    y = "Trials per day"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 24, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.8, size = 24),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1)
  )

```
